property.address: 6 Crown Point Rd, West Deptford, NJ 08086
property.description: Former gas station in an overlay zone in West Deptford Township. Zoned both M-2 and R-4. Tanks have been pumped when the gas station was shut down per Seller. Building needs structural work. On a highly trafficked road that connects Paulsboro and West Deptford, with many approved uses. 2 Garage bays with existing structure. Water views in rear of property. Vacant and ready for next owner. Sale Conditions: Distress Sale. Frontage: 42' on Crown Point Rd. Parking: 5 spaces. Fee Simple.

tax.verdict: MASSIVE — assessment severely stale (2.0% of ask)

Worst Case — UST Remediation Nightmare +.description: UST remediation costs exceed $100K. Building condemned, demolition required. Holding costs (taxes $2,475/yr + insurance $1,500/yr × 5yr). Exit value: land minus demo/remediation liability. Total loss.

Baseline — Vacant Holding (As-Is).description: Hold vacant. Pay taxes ($2,475) + insurance/maintenance (~$2,500/yr). 5-year carrying cost: $25K. Exit at land value only. No environmental remediation attempted.

Phase 1 Optimize — Lease as Auto Repair/.description: $15K capex for cosmetic cleanup + Phase I environmental (clean report). Lease to auto repair or contractor at $10/SF NNN. 2 existing garage bays are ideal. Exit at 8.5% cap on stabilized NOI $19,775.

Phase 2 Expand — M-2 Industrial Redevelo.description: Leverage M-2 zoning for industrial conversion — storage yard, distribution point, or contractor facility. $25K capex for lot improvements + building stabilization. Rent at $12/SF. Exit at 8.25% cap.

Phase 3 Strategic — R-4 Residential Land.description: Assemble adjacent parcels. Rezone fully to residential under R-4 overlay. Sell to multi-family developer at $25/SF land value. Environmental cleared. High risk, high optionality, long timeline.

cap_rate_method.description: Based on Phase 1 NOI, no current income

income.description: Vacant — no current income. Baseline holding cost shown.

red_flags.flag: Former gas station with USTs — Phase I/II environmental assessment REQUIRED before purchase. Remediation liability could exceed property value.
Building needs structural work per listing — 1920 construction, 106 years old, may not be insurable in current condition.
MASSIVE tax bomb: assessment is 2% of ask ($30K vs $99K). Post-sale tax jumps 4,850% from $50 to $2,475/yr.
Distress sale — seller motivated. Vacant with zero income. No operating history to verify.
0.34 AC lot is small for industrial redevelopment. Frontage only 42 ft limits visibility/truck access.
UST 'pumped' claim unverified — tank removal and soil testing needed. NJDEP case may already be open.

positives.flag: Dual M-2/R-4 overlay zoning provides significant optionality — industrial or residential redevelopment paths.
Highly trafficked Crown Point Rd (100/100 drivability score) — connects Paulsboro to West Deptford.
2 existing garage bays — plug-and-play for auto repair, contractor, or service business.
Fee simple ownership — no condo complications, full land rights.
Low absolute price ($99K / $39.60/SF) — potential for high equity multiple if environmental clears.
Water views — minor amenity premium for certain end uses.
